alert_news.title: AIIMS Delhi Repairs a Baby's Spinal Defect Inside the Womb in India's First Open Foetal Surgery
bullets: AIIMS Delhi performed India's first open foetal spinal surgery to repair a lumbosacral myelomeningocele at 25 weeks gestation.
The multidisciplinary team of 37 doctors operated for over six hours, successfully repairing the defect and allowing the pregnancy to continue.

alert_news.title: Cold Calling: Film chronicles how scientists braved extreme conditions to build India's first ...
bullets: India’s first permanent research station in Antarctica, established during the 1983–84 summer season by a joint team of Indian scientists and armed forces.
Built in a single Antarctic summer (six months), the station remains operational, enabling year‑round scientific research.
The station was constructed under the Indian Antarctic Programme, marking India’s entry into sustained polar research.

alert_news.title: Dholera becomes India's first semiconductor city
bullets: Dholera Special Investment Region (DSIR) in Gujarat is India's first semiconductor city, developed by the Gujarat government and the Ministry of Electronics & IT.
The city hosts the Tata Electronics Semiconductor Fabrication Facility, marking a major step in India's semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem.

alert_news.title: Smart AI Navigation Enables India's First Day Care Bilateral Hip Replacement at Max Super ...
bullets: India's first day‑care bilateral total hip replacement performed at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, using Smart AI Navigation technology.
Procedure on a 40‑year‑old patient with same‑day discharge, marking the first of its kind in India.
Smart AI Navigation enabled precise implant positioning and early mobilisation, allowing same‑day discharge.

alert_news.title: India’s first permanent research station in Antarctica
bullets: India’s first permanent research station in Antarctica, established in 1971 during the country’s third expedition to the continent
Built in a single Antarctic summer (six months) by a team of 81 scientists and Army, Navy, and Air Force personnel
Location: Antarctica; significance: enabled continuous year‑round scientific research in the region

alert_news.title: CSL, NeST Unveil India First Hybrid Laser Arc Welding Tech
bullets: India’s first indigenously designed Hybrid Laser Arc Welding (HLAW) technology unveiled by Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) and SFO Technologies at the Advanced Laser Engineering Centre, Kalamassery, Kochi.
The system integrates a 12 kW fibre laser, a six‑axis industrial robot and MIG welding, achieving welding speeds of up to 2 metres per minute for automated ship panel fabrication.

alert_news.title: NIBE Successfully Tests Made-in-India SURyaSTRA Universal Rocket Launcher up to 300 km
bullets: India’s first domestically produced Universal Rocket Launcher System (URLS) – SURyaSTRA – successfully tested by NIBE Limited at the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur, Odisha.
The platform delivers a 300 km strike range with a circular error probable of less than 5 metres and can launch 122 mm, 160 mm and 306 mm rockets from a single modular launcher.

alert_news.title: Mysuru Gets India's First 8K LED Dome Planetarium Where You Can Explore The Universe
bullets: India’s first 8K‑resolution LED dome planetarium – COSMOS‑Mysuru – inaugurated on the University of Mysore campus, Mysuru.
The 15‑metre tilted dome contains ~6,150 LED panels, over 4.27 crore LEDs, 8K resolution and is powered by 14 master computers for real‑time astronomical visualisations.

alert_news.title: India's First LED Dome Planetarium Opens in Mysuru With COSMOS Attraction
bullets: India’s first LED dome planetarium, COSMOS, inaugurated on 13 Nov 2026 at the University of Mysore campus, Mysuru.
The facility employs advanced LED dome technology to deliver immersive astronomy displays for students, researchers and the public.
